prompt: How can the other handle fit both sides?
promptZh: 另一款把手為何能裝在兩側？

options.text: Its body bends to match each mount.
options.zh: 把手本體可彎曲以配合兩側安裝座。
options.whyZh: 店員沒說把手會彎，變動的是卡扣。
安裝座互為鏡像，可翻轉卡扣來對應兩側。

options.text: It connects to both mounts at once.
options.zh: 它同時接上兩側的安裝座。
options.whyZh: 同一把手可換邊，不是同時接兩側。

options.text: Both mounts can be taken off.
options.whyZh: 店員說要拆把手，不是拆安裝座。

explanationZh: 安裝座互為鏡像，可翻轉卡扣來對應兩側。
evidence: The mounts are mirror images. Your handle locks in one direction. This other handle has a catch you can flip, so it can lock on either side.

vocabulary.note: 左右相反但形狀互相對應。
